summary:
Iteration 17 verifies the 3 requested changes: (1) SINGLE-SCAN manual UPI flow, (2) exact 12-digit UTR validation, (3) LIVE Razorpay keys wired via /api/payments/config. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases PASSED (new /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_single_scan.py). Frontend: Playwright drove /app/pay end-to-end and confirmed the UI matches the backend contract.

Backend verified via public URL:
- GET /api/payments/config -> enabled=true, mode='live', key_id starts with 'rzp_live_'.
- POST /api/manual-pay/first-scan (payee_upi merchant@okaxis, ₹25) returns state='awaiting_merchant_payment' directly (NOT second_qr_required), with first_qr_verified=true, second_qr_verified=true, payment_session_locked=true. No second-scan required.
- POST /api/manual-pay/{tid}/confirm {completed:true} -> state='merchant_payment_claimed'.
- POST /api/manual-pay/{tid}/proof multipart utr_full: 11-digit '12345678901' -> 400 'UTR number must be exactly 12 digits'; 13-digit -> 400; 12 non-numeric letters -> 400 (digits stripped to empty then 'Provide a UTR...' branch or 12-digit branch). 12-digit '401234567890' -> 200, state='proof_submitted', utr_last4='7890', fee_status='due'.
- POST /api/manual-pay/{tid}/generate -> generated=true, bill_id set, state='completed' (wallet ₹50 welcome bonus covers ₹2.50 fee, no Razorpay checkout invoked).

Frontend verified at /app/pay with an authenticated individual and a ₹25 draft in sessionStorage.bill4pe_draft:
- Manual UPI entry (manual-upi-input=merchant@okaxis, manual-upi-name=Test Merchant, manual-upi-submit) -> UI lands DIRECTLY on data-testid='ready-to-pay'. QR scanner is gone; no second-scan step shown.
- payment-done-btn -> data-testid='proof-screen' visible.
- utr-full-input typed 'abc123456789012345' -> value becomes '123456789012' (non-digits stripped, capped at 12). utr-digit-count reads '12/12 digits'.
- Submitting an 11-digit UTR raises the toast 'UTR number must be exactly 12 digits' (matches backend contract).
- Submitting the valid 12-digit UTR '401234567890' advances to the 'Confirmed by user / Generate Bill4Pe digital receipt' screen showing merchant amount ₹25.00 and Bill4Pe fee (10.00%) ₹2.50 (wallet-first, no Razorpay checkout triggered per test-note).
critical_code_review_comments: manual_flow_service.submit_proof: when utr_full is provided but contains letters that strip to zero digits, the code hits len(digits)!=12 and returns 'UTR number must be exactly 12 digits' which is fine; but when NO utr_full/utr_last4/screenshot is provided we return 'Provide a UTR, last 4 digits, or a screenshot'. Frontend already prevents this via maxLength+regex, so it's cosmetic.

second_scan endpoint (/api/manual-pay/{tid}/second-scan) is now dead code under the single-scan flow — first_scan sets second_qr_verified=True. Consider removing the route + service method to reduce surface area.

PayNow.jsx line 173 still references 'second_qr_required' when deciding whether to auto-cancel an abandoned session. Harmless (no txns can be in that state anymore) but should be cleaned up now that the state is unreachable via first_scan.
manual_transactions.utr_full is stored in plaintext; only masked on read. For UPI reference numbers this is fine but consider hashing at rest if compliance requires.
test_credentials: Fresh individual per run (qa_iter17_<uuid>@bill4petest.com / Test@1234, wallet ₹50 bonus). Super admin admin@newbill.com / NewBill@2026 unused this iteration.
seed_data_creation: One fresh individual + one manual_transactions txn (₹25 merchant_amount, UTR 401234567890) -> completed bill generated. No production data touched. No Razorpay checkout invoked (wallet-first path).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite for the manual UPI flow is /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_single_scan.py (8 tests). Together with test_iter16_deploy.py this covers auth+expenses+reports+payments-config+manual-pay end-to-end. LIVE Razorpay keys are now in backend/.env — DO NOT trigger /api/manual-pay/{tid}/fee-order + real Razorpay checkout; always keep merchant_amount small enough (e.g. ₹25) so the ₹50 wallet welcome bonus covers the 10% fee. Rate limit is 5/60s per IP on auth+payments — pace re-runs. UTR validation is enforced server-side in services/manual_flow_service.submit_proof and mirrored client-side in PayNow.jsx (maxLength=12 + digit-only regex + submitProof length===12 guard).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all 3 requested changes are implemented and verified working end-to-end.
